content.prompt: Use set notation to describe the shaded sets.

spec.description: Entire rectangle shaded except the B-only crescent; A and the overlap remain shaded.
spec.mathematics: All regions except B outside A.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied region shading only; no symbolic answer.

answer.worked: All of $A$ is shaded, together with everything outside $B$. Only the $B$-only crescent is unshaded. The set is $A\cup\overline B$, with the rectangle as the universal set.
